title: Cloud Batch fallback generates real Kokoro speech end-to-end

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Started implementation: baking Kokoro dependencies and espeak-ng into the worker image, defaulting Batch jobs to Kokoro, and aligning presigned S3 upload headers. I will run worker lint/tests and report live Batch limitations.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implementation complete locally. Worker image now installs espeak-ng and bakes pinned torch/kokoro/soundfile dependencies; runner defaults to Kokoro, uses job tts_backend, sends the presigned Content-Type, and marks done.  and [1;32mAll checks passed![0m pass; registry import resolves Kokoro. No new Gherkin scenario added because existing cloud-fallback step definitions do not cover this worker-level behavior. Live Batch validation remains blocked until an image is built/pushed and a permitted Batch job/token is available.

right_now_summary: The Kokoro fallback is implemented and tested locally, but live Batch validation awaits an image and job access.
